title: Hearty Russian Beef Pilaf
description: A cultured and silky post-workout Russian dish featuring ground pistachios, this ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly pilaf is cooked to perfection in an iron teppan, utilizing mushimono-steam for a moist and flavorful result.
instructions: Heat the iron teppan over medium-high heat and add the ground beef, cooking until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion, grated carrots, and minced garlic to the teppan and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the ground pistachios, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the long grain rice to the teppan, stirring to combine with the beef and vegetable mixture, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the beef broth to the teppan, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the teppan, and steam the pilaf using the mushimono-steam method for 20 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Remove the teppan from the heat and let the pilaf rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
